title: Trade Associations' Roles to Drive Industry Transformation Maps
what_it_is: Trade Associations' Roles to Drive Industry Transformation Maps

sections.label: ITM sectors and economic agencies
sections.summary: The 23 ITM sectors, about 80% of GDP, will launch by end of this year, with six ITMs already launched and each led by an economic agency.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: The 23 ITM sectors, which account for about 80% of our gross domestic product, will be launched by the end of this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: To date, we have launched six ITMs for the retail, hotel, food services, precision engineering, logistics and food manufacturing sectors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Each of these ITMs would be led by one of our economic agencies that include the Economic Development Board, International Enterprise (IE) Singapore, SPRING Singapore and Singapore Tourism Board.

sections.label: TACs in industry development
sections.summary: TACs can play an important role in industry development in sectors without an ITM by focusing on priority areas and tapping Government schemes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Even in sectors for which we do not yet have an ITM, TACs can play an important role in industry development by focusing on priority areas and tapping on Government schemes for assistance.

sections.label: LEAD support for TACs
sections.summary: SPRING and IE Singapore supported SFMA and CDAS through LEAD, which helps TACs build capacity and improve productivity, innovation and internationalisation, as the Print and Media Association is doing.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: SFMA and CDAS were supported in these efforts by SPRING and IE Singapore through the Local Enterprise and Association Development (LEAD) 	programme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: LEAD is an important source of support for TACs to enhance their capacity and to help their industries improve productivity, innovate and internationalise, even if there is no ITM.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: For example, the Print and Media Association of Singapore, for which there is no specific ITM, is tapping on LEAD to build a training academy, develop a machine capacity sharing platform, and support knowledge sharing and research and development collaborations in the industry.

sections.label: Message to TACs
sections.summary: TACs with proposals to enhance skills, productivity, innovation or internationalisation in their industry need not wait for an ITM to be launched.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: My message to TACs is this: if you have a proposal to address a need to enhance skills, productivity, innovation or internationalisation in your industry, there is no need to wait for an ITM to be launched.
